description: This file is an extension of the ChannelsStore class, providing asynchronous methods to load, update, and save configuration schemas and values. It handles network requests, config data manipulation, and UI-related configuration adjustments within an OpenClaw-based application.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from a network source and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current configuration snapshot from the network and updates local configuration state.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Sets UI-specific configuration parameters, such as seam color, based on the loaded config snapshot.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration schema for a specific channel identified by channelId.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value at a specified path from the draft configuration.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates a configuration value at a specified path in the draft configuration and marks the configuration as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration to persistent storage and reloads the latest configuration from the network.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the network to refresh the draft.
